test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

I gifted a soft toy to my daughter.

options.text: A soft toy is gifted to my daughter by me.
To my daughter was gifted a soft toy by me.
A soft toy was gifted to my daughter by me.
A soft toy was being gifted to my daughter by me.

solution:
The correct passive voice is: **A soft toy was gifted to my daughter by me.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the active voice with the subject "**I**" performing the action.
 
• In passive voice, the subject becomes the receiver of the action and is placed at the beginning of the sentence.
 
• The object "**soft toy**" becomes the subject in passive voice and "**gifted**" is changed to "**was gifted**".
 
• The preposition "**to**" remains the same and "**my daughter**" becomes the object of the preposition.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1**: The sentence is in passive voice but the subject is not at the beginning and the preposition is incorrect.
 
• **Option 2**: The sentence is in passive voice but the word order is incorrect and the preposition is incorrect.
 
• **Option 4**: The sentence is in passive voice but the tense is incorrect and the preposition is incorrect.
